From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@novapay.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up + quick budget check (NovaPay)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call this morning — really helpful to understand NovaPay's roadmap for in-product fraud scoring and two-ticket support triage. Quick recap and two asks so we can size next steps: 

Recap (from our notes):
- Primary use: real-time scoring + short-form contextual prompts for agent assist (~512 tokens per request typical; some longer evaluation calls up to ~2k tokens).
- Estimated volume today: pilot 3-5M tokens/month, projected to 10-20M within 6 months if pilot shows <150ms p50 latency.
- Compliance: data residency in US, SOC2 evidence required for procurement.

Two asks:
1) Can you confirm a realistic monthly spend band (monthly budget range) you have in mind for the pilot and the 6-month target? E.g., <$5k, $5-25k, $25-75k, $75k+.
2) Any procurement thresholds/process items we should plan for (e.g., minimum PO, legal review timeline, vendor form)?

To help, I can share a quick unit-economics example (tokens -> $/1M tokens) and a few pricing bands we typically see for this volume. If helpful, I'll loop in Marissa (pricing/enterprise) and Rishi (sales lead) to provide formal ranges.

Thanks — I'll send a compact spreadsheet with example spend bands after your note.

Best,
Dylan

Subject: Re: Follow-up + quick budget check (NovaPay)

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the summary — that matches our notes. Quick answers below: 

1) Pilot budget: planning for ~$8-12k/month for an initial 2-3 month pilot (proof points: latency & prediction quality). If pilot succeeds, procurement will consider a committed spend band in the $40-120k/month range for the next 6-12 months (depends on SLA and dedicated capacity).

2) Procurement thresholds/process:
- Any vendor >$50k/year requires security questionnaire + legal review (SOC2 + limited pen test report).
- Purchase orders are preferred; typical procurement timeline is 4-6 weeks post-PO.
- We have a standard vendor form; I attached the RFP we used internally for feature priorities.

Rough estimated token volumes: pilot ~10M tokens/month (mixed short/long requests); scale case 50-200M tokens/month depending on adoption curve. These are ballpark numbers — I can share more precise monthly user/request counts if that helps.

Tom, jumping in — anything to add on procurement?

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Johnson
Head of Integrations | NovaPay

Subject: Re: Follow-up + quick budget check (NovaPay) — pricing bands and $/1M token examples

Sarah / Tom —

Appreciate the clarity on budgets and procurement thresholds. Looping in Marissa (pricing) and Rishi (sales lead) to provide formal spend bands and a quick unit-economics example so you have a concrete reference for procurement.

Attached is a compact estimate (usage-estimates.xlsx) with three scenarios we typically model:
- Pilot (10M tokens/mo): target $/1M tokens = $120-$200 (depending on model family & reserved commit) -> monthly $1.2k-$2k (note: these are per-1M token unit prices; pilot MSR may include minimal infra and support credits).
- Scale (50M tokens/mo): target $/1M tokens = $60-$100 -> monthly $3k-$5k.
- Dedicated/Enterprise (150M+ tokens/mo): target $/1M tokens = $20-$40 with reserved capacity commitments and quantization/efficiency optimizations.

Key notes:
- Unit economics vary by model (open vs third-party) and execs often prefer us to propose both a hosted API plan and a dedicated capacity estimate for mid/large tiers.
- For procurement >$50k/year your security docs (SOC2) and a standard vendor form are usually sufficient; for >$250k we typically see additional legal negotiation on liability and data processing addenda.

Marissa — can you confirm the typical $/1M token ranges you'd propose for a 10M pilot vs the 50-150M scale bands? Also tagging Rishi to confirm deal id and next steps.

Thanks,
Dylan
[Attachment: usage-estimates.xlsx (XLSX) - example unit economics & monthly bands]

Sarah —

Thanks for the details and the RFP — helpful. Quick concrete bands from our side to align with NovaPay procurement thresholds: 

Suggested pricing bands (hosted API example):
- Pilot (<= 10M tokens/mo): $150 / 1M tokens -> approx $1.5k/mo
- Growth (10-50M tokens/mo): $80 / 1M tokens -> $800-$4k/mo (tiered scale pricing)
- Production (50-200M tokens/mo): $35 / 1M tokens with reserved commit -> $1.75k-$7k/mo; for >150M we recommend a dedicated capacity proposal (custom pricing, typically $20-$30 / 1M tokens with committed throughput).

Procurement & next steps:
- Because NovaPay notes procurement review for >$50k/year, it looks like the pilot will be under that threshold. If you expect to move to $40-120k/month quickly, we should start the security pack and legal intake now.
- Action items:
  1) Sarah to confirm pilot target token volume (final number for our PO/quote).
  2) NovaPay to share completed vendor form + preferred PO terms (net30/45).
  3) Rishi/Marissa to send formal quote and mutual action plan (MAP) — we can target an internal procurement-ready packet within 5 business days of the vendor form.

Doc links: vendor form / PO template (attached via DocuSign): https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/abc123

If helpful, I can also schedule a 30-minute procurement intake with our legal ops to speed review.

Best,
